plain_statement: It is false that the explicit list of exactly 32 AND and OR gates in the statement, each reading two earlier wires, with the 31st gate as output, on the Fano plane with inputs x0..x6 then y0..y6, is true on exactly the five flags (0,0), (1,0), (2,0), (1,3), (2,5) among inputs with one point and one line through it, and, among inputs with no point on any line that is on, true exactly on {x1, x2, y1, y2} and {x0, x5, y4, y5}.
title: The witness-B claims fail: the explicit 32-gate fan-in-two AND/OR Fano circuit accepts other flags than the five named or other flag-free inputs than the two
